title: SETARAM
content: SETARAM is a French instrumentation company focused on thermal analysis, calorimetry, and sorption measurement systems. These techniques are relevant to aerogel development and benchmarking where thermal behavior, sorption response, and advanced materials testing are important. SETARAM fits the Equipment Materials category as a specialized measurement supplier for research and industrial laboratories.
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
